rootCause: CpfBatchRemoteCodec advertises Spring Batch StepExecution as an allowed Kafka reply payload and serializes it with generic Jackson, but StepExecution has no Jackson creator. The Manager therefore cannot deserialize any successful Worker reply, records REPLY FAILED with IllegalArgumentException, retries three times, emits DLT and leaves the Job STARTED until the HTTP caller times out.
constraints: Do not use Java native serialization or open polymorphic deserialization
Preserve the bounded allowlist and canonical owner context
Fix the Runtime codec owner and verify actual fresh Worker-to-Manager replies
